name: Hex: Two Can Play

description.content: While this Hex is dull, each time you are blinded or stunned by a Survivor [2] times, a Dull Totem ignites.
Whenever you are blinded or stunned by a Survivor you are not carrying, they are blinded for [1.5s].

quote: "From now on, no more Mr. Good Guy." -Chucky
